names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 21 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Ευγένιος», with the rank word left off. The page gives him no byname at all, which is why the display name carries the day instead.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 21ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Ευγένιος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 21 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its whole notice is «Ο Άγιος Ευγένιος μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους. Δεν έχουμε άλλες λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του». The corpus's men of the name are Eugene of Cherson, Eugene of Trebizond, Eugene son of Paul and Tatta, Eugenius of Rome, Eugenius the Confessor and Eugenius the father of Mary called Marinos, all on other days and all with lives of their own; this one has nothing but the sword, so the display name carries the day as the corpus does elsewhere for a bare name. No year, no century, so there is no `dates` object. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
